form.logoUrlHint: A link to a picture. Uploading a file comes later.

hours.intro: Set the opening hours for each day. A range may end after midnight, and then it belongs to the day it started on.

printers.empty: This branch has no printers yet.
printers.name: Name

menu.title: Menu
menu.noBrand: There is no brand to build a menu for yet.
menu.readOnly: You can see the menu but you cannot change it.

categories.intro: Categories group the items on the terminals. Drag a category, or use its arrows, to change the order the terminals show.
categories.hint: A category is never deleted. When you deactivate it, its items stay in old orders but are not sold.

messages.deactivated: Category deactivated. Its items are not on the terminals any more.

items.needCategory: Add a category first: every item belongs to a category.

item.created: Item created. Next, set the prices of the branches and the modifiers.
item.readOnly: You can see this item but you cannot change it.

form.descriptionHint: Optional. Write it in both languages, or leave both empty.
form.basePriceHint: The price at every branch, unless a branch sets its own.
form.imageUrlHint: A link to a picture. Uploading a file comes later.
form.activeHint: Leave this off to set the item up before it is sold.

messages.deactivated: The item is deactivated. It is no longer sold.

item.deactivateHint: An item is never deleted: old orders keep its name and price. A deactivated item is not on any terminal.

pricing.intro: A branch can sell this item at its own price, switch it off, or sell it only at certain times. A branch you do not change uses the brand's settings.
pricing.empty: There are no branches to show.

form.priceHint: Leave empty to use the brand price ({{price}}).
form.scheduleHint: The times are read on the clock of the branch.

modifiers.intro: Modifiers are the choices a guest makes for this item, such as a size or extra toppings. A group whose fewest choices is 1 or more must be answered before the item is added.
modifiers.empty: This item has no modifiers yet.
modifiers.noModifiers: This group has no modifiers yet.

group.minSelectHint: 0 makes the group optional. 1 or more makes it required.
group.maxSelectHint: How many modifiers a guest can pick from this group.

modifier.priceDeltaHint: What it adds to the price of the item. Use a minus sign for a discount, for example -2.000.

modifiers.hint: Nothing is deleted. A group or a modifier that is deactivated is not on the terminals, and old orders keep it.

combos.intro: A combo is one price for a set of choices. Each choice (a pizza, a side, a drink) is filled by one of the items you allow for it.
combos.needItems: Add some items first: a combo is made of items.

combo.readOnly: You can see this combo but you cannot change it.

form.priceHint: What the guest pays for the combo. The extra charges of the items they choose come on top.
form.activeHint: A combo that is not active is not on any terminal. Leave it off to set it up first.

slots.title: Choices
slots.hint: Each choice is one place in the combo. The guest picks one of its items.
slots.optionsHint: An item can have an extra charge, for example a bigger drink. Leave it empty for none.
